body.condition: For every \(t\in\{1,\ldots,T\}\) and every \(z_{1:t},z'_{1:t}\in\mathcal H_t\) with \(z_t=z'_t\), \[\lvert Y_t(z_{1:t})-Y_t(z'_{1:t})\rvert\le\sum_{\ell=1}^{t-1}C(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}\mathbf 1\{z_{t-\ell}\ne z'_{t-\ell}\}.\]

novel.justification: The condition represents persistent but decaying queue, inventory, congestion, and marketplace-state effects without requiring a stochastic state equation. Additive distributed-lag systems with coefficients bounded by \(C(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}\), and nonlinear Lipschitz recursions with the same coordinate sensitivities, satisfy it.
